title: Dad's last shift
summary: Your dad is finishing at the works after thirty-one years, and his last shift ends at two on a Saturday. They're doing a presentation in the canteen. A season on, he's retired and comes to everything.

ends.title: The gate
ends.text: You were at the works gate when your dad came out after thirty-one years.

ends.title: The video
ends.text: You sent a video to your dad's leaving do. They played it twice.

event.title: The last shift
event.speaker: dad
setup: {dad.name} is finishing at the works after thirty-one years. His last shift ends at two on Saturday, with a presentation in the canteen. Your kick-off is at three, forty minutes away.

say: "Don't you dare come. You've got a game. They're giving me a clock. Who wants a clock? I'll tell you about it after."

replies.label: "I'll send them a video for the canteen."
"I'll be at the gate at two."

gate.text: Two o'clock. You're at the works gate in your club suit. He comes out with a clock under his arm and stops dead. Then he shows you the clock. You're ten minutes late for the warm-up and the gaffer lets it go when he hears why.

video.text: You record it in the kitchen: thirty-one years, a thank you, a joke about the clock. They play it twice in the canteen. He rings you at half past two and can't really talk.

ok.text: He rings at six. The clock is very nice. He's put it on the mantelpiece and he doesn't know what to do with Monday.

event.title: Monday
event.speaker: dad
setup: A season on. Your dad's retired, and he comes to everything now, training included. He's on the bench by pitch two with a flask, watching.
{if arc.path=='gate'}The clock's at your house now. He says it's too loud for his.{/if}

outcomes.text: He comes and stands on the touchline. The coach asks him to hold the cones. He holds them like it's a job, because it is now.
He comes over and holds the cones. The lads call him Clock.
He watches the whole session and leaves before the end, so you won't feel watched.
He watches the whole session and says nothing about it after, except the cones were wrong.
